headline: alice can read bob's resource /api/notes/2 — broken access control
evidence: the actor received the same resource the owner did (identical response fingerprint); no copy of the data is kept
fix: on /api/notes/2, check that the logged-in user owns (or is allowed) the requested object before returning it, server-side
apply the same owner check to every endpoint that returns a user's object, not just this one
return 404 (not 403) for someone else's object, so the endpoint doesn't reveal that it exists

headline: alice is refused /api/notes/2 (status 404); access control is enforced
